costumes.name: Pure Beginner
costumes.description:
Vesti: Tactical Upgrade costume.
Obtained from an Event Pass.

lines.text: Is something wrong, Commander? I can listen, i-if you'd like!

Um, Commander... I-I get flustered when you look at me like that.
Could you look that way, instead?
Commander, you think I'm strong... right?

You can tell me anything. After all, you and I... are friends, aren't we?
Hehe. I said it. F-friends...

Commander, my face feels really warm...
Do you know why that is...?

What's inside my shawl?
Here, I'll show you... b-but only you, Commander.
... Y-you're not gonna leave me alone like this forever, are you?
Kitty, when do you think the Commander will be back? I bet it won't be too long... But I really can't wait... Hehe.
Let's leave the Armory to Eu-Eunhwa and... hang out! Just the two of u-us... as friends!
Emma said rest is important, so... why don't y-you and I rest together?

Where would you like to go, Commander?
I-I'm fine with anywhere, as long as it's with you.
If anyone tries to hurt you or our squad, I'll wipe them out with my missiles! So, please continue looking out for us...
I'll keep getting stronger...!
With this, I can kill even more.
Those bullies can't do anything to me anymore!
I-is this for me? R-really?

Th-thank you, Commander.
Hehe... I love it.
I had something for you too... I'll be sure to br-bring it next time.
I'll try even harder to make you proud of me, Commander... because we're b-besties!
I... I don't think "friends" is enough anymore. Wh-what comes after friends...?
I-I want to stay with you f-forever, Commander. Always.
O-okay! I'll do my best!
Um... Wh-what should I do...?
Is this the r-right path?
I'm ready to fight.
Engaging the enemy now! Let's kill them all!
Target sighted. Do I just crush them?
I-I'll be right back!
H-hold on! Reloading is taking longer than I thought...
G-get any closer, and you're all dead!
C-can you cover me, please?
Target locked.
Missile container online. Full barrage, fire!
G-good! Blow them all to pieces!
D-did you see that, Commander?
I-I did it!
Hehe... They're all dead?
Ah!
Ugh!
Ah!
I-I'm sorry, C-Commander... I... I couldn't win...
As long as I'm with you, Commander... I-I think I can do even better!
I-I never imagined I'd get to wear a school uniform. It feels different. It's making me excited... Hehe.
Hehe. I said I was going to school, so Emma helped me pick out this uniform.
C-Commander, look at this ribbon on my chest... I really like it.
C-Commander, how do you like this uniform? Do you think it suits me...?
You want to know what's in my bag? Well, I wasn't sure what to bring, so... I brought everything.
If I'd really gone to school with you, we would've been friends, right? I would've been the new kid, and you could've shown me around... Hehe...
I-I'm all ready to go... I wonder what's taking the Commander so long...?
I got all ready while I was waiting... b-but maybe I should pack more stuff in my bag, just to be sure.
I-it would be fun to walk around in school uniforms with Eunhwa and Emma.
I-it feels like I'm skipping class to go hang out, hehe.
I-I think I could go to class at the Tactics Academy dressed like this... You'll go with me, won't you, Commander?
I got myself a school uniform! What do you think? D-do I look okay?
Th-this'll make me look like less of a new student, right...?
When I'm with you, I feel like I grow so much stronger.
Now I can wipe them all out... Wait, students don't say things like that, huh...?
A p-present? Hehe. Is this to celebrate me starting school?
I'm going to treasure this, since you're the one who gave it to me.
A present? From you...? For some reason, I-I'm so nervous...
For you, Commander, I'll work even harder...!
I-if you don't mind, I'd like us to stay together for... Uhh, never mind.
Wanna hang out after class? ... I-I'm sorry, Commander. I just wanted to pretend like we're at school. Hehe...
I-I'm all ready.
Commander...? Wh-what is it?
R-right... I'm going.
I see the enemy... Am I cleared to fire...?
Leave it to me, C-Commander...
Let's end this before my uniform gets dirty...
D-don't underestimate... new students...!
W-wait, I've got more ammo in my bag...
I-I'll reload real fast.
I didn't tear my uniform, right...?
Now I can wipe them all out.
Target acquired. Full barrage, fire!
Now...! Blow them all to pieces!
Was that okay...?
I got one...
Hehe. I did it!
Ouch!
Ugh...
Ow...
Sorry, Commander... I may be dressed like a student, but that's no excuse for this...
W-we did it, Commander. This means I'll make it to school tomorrow, right...? Hehe.
